parameters.query:
SELECT
  wm.message_id,
  wm.chat_jid,
  wm.is_group,
  COALESCE(
    CASE WHEN wm.whatsapp_timestamp IS NOT NULL AND wm.whatsapp_timestamp > 0
      THEN to_timestamp(wm.whatsapp_timestamp)
    END,
    wm.received_at,
    wm.created_date
  ) AS message_at,
  wm.message_body,
  wm.content_type,
  wm.sender_phone,
  wm.has_media,
  COALESCE(string_agg(DISTINCT wmi.content, ' | '), '') AS media_text,
  'media_interpretation' AS source_kind
FROM actionnow.whatsapp_media_interpretations wmi
INNER JOIN actionnow.whatsapp_messages wm
  ON wm.message_id = wmi.message_id
WHERE wmi.status = 'done'
  AND wmi.updated_date >= $2::timestamptz
  AND wmi.updated_date <= $3::timestamptz
  AND $1::text IS NOT NULL AND $1 <> '' AND (
    wmi.owner_phone_num = $1
    OR wmi.owner_phone_num = regexp_replace($1, '^\+', '')
    OR wmi.owner_phone_num = ('+' || regexp_replace($1, '\D', '', 'g'))
    OR regexp_replace(wmi.owner_phone_num, '\D', '', 'g') = regexp_replace($1, '\D', '', 'g')
    OR wm.owner_phone_num = $1
    OR wm.owner_phone_num = regexp_replace($1, '^\+', '')
    OR wm.owner_phone_num = ('+' || regexp_replace($1, '\D', '', 'g'))
    OR regexp_replace(wm.owner_phone_num, '\D', '', 'g') = regexp_replace($1, '\D', '', 'g')
  )
  AND wm.from_me = false
  AND (
    (cardinality($4::text[]) > 0 AND wm.chat_jid = ANY($4::text[]))
    OR (cardinality($5::text[]) > 0 AND wm.chat_jid = ANY($5::text[]))
  )
GROUP BY wm.id, wm.message_id, wm.chat_jid, wm.is_group, wm.whatsapp_timestamp,
         wm.received_at, wm.created_date, wm.message_body, wm.content_type,
         wm.sender_phone, wm.has_media
ORDER BY message_at DESC
LIMIT 200;

  '' AS media_text,

  OR wm.owner_phone_num = regexp_replace($1, '^\+', '')
  OR wm.owner_phone_num = ('+' || regexp_replace($1, '\D', '', 'g'))
  OR regexp_replace(wm.owner_phone_num, '\D', '', 'g') = regexp_replace($1, '\D', '', 'g')
)
  AND COALESCE(
    CASE WHEN wm.whatsapp_timestamp IS NOT NULL AND wm.whatsapp_timestamp > 0
      THEN to_timestamp(wm.whatsapp_timestamp)
    END,
    wm.received_at,
    wm.created_date
  ) >= $2::timestamptz
  AND COALESCE(
    CASE WHEN wm.whatsapp_timestamp IS NOT NULL AND wm.whatsapp_timestamp > 0
      THEN to_timestamp(wm.whatsapp_timestamp)
    END,
    wm.received_at,
    wm.created_date
  ) <= $3::timestamptz

  AND (wm.has_media = false OR wm.content_type = 'text')

    (cardinality($4::text[]) > 0 AND wm.chat_jid = ANY($4::text[]))
    OR (cardinality($5::text[]) > 0 AND wm.chat_jid = ANY($5::text[]))
  )
ORDER BY message_at DESC

  NULLIF($5, '')::timestamptz, $6::timestamptz, $7::timestamptz,
  NULL, $8::integer, false,
  NULLIF($9, ''), $10::jsonb, 0,
  $11::text[], $12::text[], NULL,

)
RETURNING id, outcome, relevance_score, passes_threshold, monitor_setting_id;

SELECT
  ms.*,
  uwc.api_key,
  uwc.phone_number AS connection_phone,
  uwc.status AS connection_status,
  uwc.wasender_session_id
FROM actionnow.monitor_settings ms
INNER JOIN actionnow.user_whatsapp_connections uwc
  ON regexp_replace(uwc.phone_number, '\D', '', 'g') = regexp_replace(COALESCE(ms.owner_phone_num, ''), '\D', '', 'g')
WHERE ms.from_date IS NOT NULL
  AND cardinality(COALESCE(ms.from_group_ids, '{}'::text[])) > 0
  AND cardinality(COALESCE(ms.to_receipient_phone_ids, '{}'::text[])) > 0
  AND uwc.status = 'connected'
  AND uwc.api_key IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY ms.created_date DESC;
